summary: The official archive lists the December 1987 RPBS PDF and search indexing exposes extracted text, but the official bytes return HTTP 403/404 and exact Internet Archive availability/CDX queries return no capture. This verifies publication identity, not bytes.
PBS copyright terms reserve rights beyond limited personal/reference reproduction; local acquisition does not authorize public raw-payload redistribution.

Compared 1,049 official PDF targets with 1,033 distinct Internet Archive CDX digest observations: 298 exact byte-digest matches, four verified archived variants and 747 targets without an archive capture. December 1987 has no exact CDX capture.

Discovered and signature-validated all 655 conservatively classified official machine-readable packages from 2007-04 through 2026-07, totalling 2,905,582,497 bytes in ignored local storage. The formats are versioned CSV, XML, text and structured extracts and do not imply one stable historical API schema.

Generated four Hugging Face-compatible provenance configurations containing URLs, checksums, periods, archive observations, rights states and transformations, with zero raw payloads and no restricted descriptors.

All 27 canonical local quality gates passed, including 674 tests, BasedPyright, Ruff, Bandit, package build, public-data policy, source validation/contracts, npm audit and dashboard build. Repository and evidence release readiness are true; current-head hosted review remains separate.

PR review identified that HTTP and HTTPS archive originals represent the same source identity. Transport-neutral matching corrected exact matches from 298 to 690, no-capture rows from 747 to 354 and differing variants from four to five. All five variants are locally byte-verified against their CDX digests; original capture schemes remain preserved for replay.

PR #784 merged to protected main as 083be8aa after every exact-head hosted check passed and three review findings were addressed. PR #785 then removed broad seed-tree publication and legacy remote seed files, merging as dd7c7592 after all hosted checks passed.

GitHub Actions run 33237003418 published the 12 allow-listed medallion configurations to the configured Hugging Face dataset. Remote verification observed all four PBS provenance configurations and no legacy data/seed tree. Raw PBS payloads were not published.

All repository-owned acceptance criteria are complete. Missing December 1987 bytes and raw-redistribution permission remain explicit external source/rights gates under issue #255 and do not invalidate the published provenance product.
